purpose: Domain-owned UI object ids for official BI collage. These ids are the target side of platform actions such as click, hover, select, assertText, assertDisabled, assertNoRequest, and download.
policy: This file names BI official UI objects and their domain semantics; it must not define platform action ids.
Each object may list supported platform actions, but the action definitions live in the platform vocabulary.
Locator hints are domain pack data, not executable helper code.
Testcase-specific expected values belong in testcase/run contracts, not in this vocabulary.
